field.name: consequence
field.doc: 🔄 Consequence class of a fatigue failure for the partial factor γ_Mf of EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1: with the assessment method (damage tolerant or safe life) it selects one of the four registry rows ndp.en1993.1-9.gamma-mf.<method>.<consequence>.

enum.name: FatigueConsequence
enum.doc: ⚠ Consequence class of a fatigue failure (EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1): low consequence or high consequence.
